PoseTrackingConfig

class PoseTrackingConfig(model_path, running_mode, num_poses, min_pose_detection_confidence, min_pose_presence_confidence, min_tracking_confidence)[source]

Bases: object

MediaPipe Pose Landmarker configuration.

Attributes:
model_pathstr

Path of the model (.task) already resolved for the platform.

running_modeAny

MediaPipe running mode (e.g. VIDEO).

num_posesint

Maximum number of detected poses.

min_pose_detection_confidencefloat

Minimum confidence for a pose to be detected.

min_pose_presence_confidencefloat

Minimum confidence for a pose to be considered present.

min_tracking_confidencefloat

Minimum confidence for a pose to be considered tracked.
